029public class FieldRepairsScript implements EveryFrameScript {
030
031        public static int MAX_DMODS_FROM_DO = 5;
032        
033        public static int MONTHS_PER_DMOD_REMOVAL = 1;
034        
035        
036        public static float RATE_DP_MAX = 40f;
037        public static float RATE_DP_MIN = 4f;
038        public static float MAX_RATE_MULT = 3f;
039        
040        public static boolean REMOVE_DMOD_FROM_NEW_SHIPS = true;
041        public static float MIN_NEW_REMOVE_PROB = 0.2f;
042        public static float NEW_REMOVE_PROB_PER_DMOD = 0.2f;
043        
044        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(10f, 20f);
045        protected IntervalUtil tracker2 = new IntervalUtil(3f, 5f);
046        protected IntervalUtil tracker3 = new IntervalUtil(20f, 40f);
047        
048        protected FleetMemberAPI pickedNew = null;
049        protected String dmodNew = null;
050        protected Random newRandom = new Random(Misc.genRandomSeed());
051        protected LinkedHashSet<String> seen = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
052        
053        protected FleetMemberAPI picked = null;
054        protected String dmod = null;
055        
056        Object readResolve() {
057                if (seen == null) {
058                        seen =  new LinkedHashSet<String>();
059                }
060                if (tracker2 == null) {
061                        tracker2 = new IntervalUtil(3f, 5f);
062                }
063                if (tracker3 == null) {
064                        tracker3 = new IntervalUtil(20f, 40f);
065                }
066                if (newRandom == null) {
067                        newRandom = new Random(Misc.genRandomSeed());
068                }
069                return this;
070        }
071        
072        public void advance(float amount) {
073                
074//              System.out.println(RecoverAPlanetkiller.getNexus().getContainingLocation().getName() +
075//                              "   " + RecoverAPlanetkiller.getNexus().getContainingLocation().getLocation());
076                
077                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
078                if (fleet == null) return;
079                
080                if (Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().getSkillLevel(Skills.DERELICT_CONTINGENT) > 0) {
081                        shuffleDMods(amount);
082                }
083                
084                if (Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) {
085                        return;
086                }
087                
088                if (Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().getSkillLevel(Skills.HULL_RESTORATION) <= 0) {
089                        picked = null;
090                        dmod = null;
091                        return;
092                }
093                
094                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
095                float rateMult = 1f / (float) MONTHS_PER_DMOD_REMOVAL;
096                //days *= 100f;
097                if (picked != null) {
098                        float dp = picked.getDeploymentPointsCost();
099                        float f = (dp - RATE_DP_MIN) / (RATE_DP_MAX - RATE_DP_MIN);
100                        f = 1 - f;
101                        if (f > 1f) f = 1f;
102                        if (f < 0f) f = 0f;
103                        
104                        rateMult *= 1f + (MAX_RATE_MULT - 1f) * f;
105                }
106                tracker.advance(days * rateMult * 0.5f); // * 0.5f since the tracker interval averages 15 days
107                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
108                        // if picked ship is no longer present in the fleet when it's time to remove the d-mod,
109                        // don't remove a d-mod at all
110                        if (picked == null || dmod == null) {
111                                pickNext();
112                        } else {
113                                if (fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().contains(picked) &&
114                                                DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(picked.getVariant()) > 0) {
115                                        
116                                        DModManager.removeDMod(picked.getVariant(), dmod);
117                                        
118                                        HullModSpecAPI spec = DModManager.getMod(dmod);
119                                        MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel(picked.getShipName() + " - repaired " + spec.getDisplayName(), Misc.getBasePlayerColor());
120                                        intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "repairs_finished"));
121                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.REFIT_TAB, picked);
122                                        
123                                        int dmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(picked.getVariant());
124                                        if (dmods <= 0) {
125                                                restoreToNonDHull(picked.getVariant());
126                                        }
127                                }
128                                picked = null;
129                                pickNext();
130                        }
131                }
132                
133                tracker2.advance(days);
134                if (tracker2.intervalElapsed() && REMOVE_DMOD_FROM_NEW_SHIPS) {
135                        if (pickedNew == null || dmodNew == null) {
136                                pickNextNew();
137                        } else {
138                                seen.add(pickedNew.getId());
139                                
140                                float numDmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(pickedNew.getVariant());
141                                if (fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().contains(pickedNew) && numDmods > 0) {
142                                        float probRemove = MIN_NEW_REMOVE_PROB + numDmods * NEW_REMOVE_PROB_PER_DMOD;
143                                        if (newRandom.nextFloat() < probRemove) {
144                                                DModManager.removeDMod(pickedNew.getVariant(), dmodNew);
145                                                
146                                                HullModSpecAPI spec = DModManager.getMod(dmodNew);
147                                                MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel(pickedNew.getShipName() + " - repaired " + spec.getDisplayName(), Misc.getBasePlayerColor());
148                                                intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "repairs_finished"));
149                                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.REFIT_TAB, pickedNew);
150                                                
151                                                int dmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(pickedNew.getVariant());
152                                                if (dmods <= 0) {
153                                                        restoreToNonDHull(pickedNew.getVariant());
154                                                }
155                                        }
156                                }
157                                pickedNew = null;
158                                pickNextNew();
159                        }
160                }
161        }
162        
163        public void pickNext() {
164                picked = null;
165                dmod = null;
166                
167                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
168                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
169                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
170                        if (member.getVariant().isStockVariant()) continue;
171                        if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
172                        if (member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.HULL_UNRESTORABLE) ||
173                                        member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_UNRESTORABLE)) continue;
174                        int dmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(member.getVariant());
175                        if (dmods > 0) {
176                                picker.add(member, 1);
177                        }
178                }
179                picked = picker.pick();
180                
181                if (picked != null) {
182                        ShipVariantAPI variant = picked.getVariant();
183                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> modPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>();
184                        for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
185                                if (DModManager.getMod(id).hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) {
186                                        if (variant.getHullSpec().getBuiltInMods().contains(id)) continue;
187                                        modPicker.add(id);
188                                }
189                        }
190                        dmod = modPicker.pick();
191                        if (dmod == null) {
192                                picked = null;
193                        }
194                }
195        }
196        
197        public void pickNextNew() {
198                pickedNew = null;
199                dmodNew = null;
200                
201                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
202                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
203                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
204                        if (member.getVariant().isStockVariant() || member.isMothballed() ||
205                                        member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.HULL_UNRESTORABLE) ||
206                                        member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_UNRESTORABLE)) {
207                                seen.add(member.getId());
208                                continue;
209                        }
210                        if (seen.contains(member.getId())) continue;
211                        int dmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(member.getVariant());
212                        if (dmods > 0) {
213                                picker.add(member, 1);
214                        } else {
215                                seen.add(member.getId());
216                        }
217                }
218                pickedNew = picker.pick();
219                
220                if (pickedNew != null) {
221                        ShipVariantAPI variant = pickedNew.getVariant();
222                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> modPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>();
223                        for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
224                                if (DModManager.getMod(id).hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) {
225                                        if (variant.getHullSpec().getBuiltInMods().contains(id)) continue;
226                                        modPicker.add(id);
227                                }
228                        }
229                        dmodNew = modPicker.pick();
230                        if (dmodNew == null) {
231                                pickedNew = null;
232                        }
233                }
234        }
235
236        public boolean isDone() {
237                return false;
238        }
239
240        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
241                return false;
242        }

244        
245        public void shuffleDMods(float amount) {
246                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
247                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
248                
249                days *= Math.max(1f, Math.min(30f, fleet.getNumShips()));
250                
251                
252                tracker3.advance(days);
253                if (tracker3.intervalElapsed()) {
254                        WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
255                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
256                                if (member.getVariant().isStockVariant() || member.isMothballed() ||
257                                                member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.HULL_UNRESTORABLE) ||
258                                                member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_UNRESTORABLE)) {
259                                        continue;
260                                }
261                                if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
262//                              if (!member.getHullId().contains("prometheus")) {
263//                                      System.out.println("wefjlwehfwe");
264//                                      continue;
265//                              }
266                                int dmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(member.getVariant());
267                                if (dmods > 0) {
268                                        picker.add(member, 1);
269                                }
270                        }
271                        FleetMemberAPI pick = picker.pick();
272                        if (pick != null) {
273                                ShipVariantAPI variant = pick.getVariant();
274                                int dmods = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(variant);
275                                WeightedRandomPicker<String> modPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>();
276                                if (dmods >= MAX_DMODS_FROM_DO) {
277                                        for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
278                                                if (DModManager.getMod(id).hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DO_CAN_NOT_REMOVE)) continue;
279                                                if (DModManager.getMod(id).hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) {
280                                                        if (variant.getHullSpec().getBuiltInMods().contains(id)) continue;
281                                                        modPicker.add(id);
282                                                }
283                                        }
284                                }
285                                String dmod = modPicker.pick();
286                                if (dmod != null) {
287                                        DModManager.removeDMod(variant, dmod);
288                                }
289                                
290                                long seed = 0;
291                                seed = pick.getId().hashCode() ^ (seed >>> 16);
292                                seed *= Global.getSector().getClock().getDay() * 23324234L;
293                                Random rand = new Random(seed);
294                                DModManager.addDMods(variant, false, 1, Tags.HULLMOD_DO_CAN_NOT_ADD, false, rand);
295                                if (dmods < MAX_DMODS_FROM_DO) {
296                                        int after = DModManager.getNumNonBuiltInDMods(variant);
297                                        if (after == dmods) {
298                                                DModManager.addDMods(variant, false, 1, Tags.HULLMOD_DO_CAN_NOT_ADD, true, rand);
299                                        }
300                                }
301                        }
302                        
303                }
304        }

306        
307        public static ShipHullSpecAPI getBaseNonDHullFor(ShipVariantAPI v) {
308                ShipHullSpecAPI base = v.getHullSpec().getDParentHull();
309                
310                // so that a skin with dmods can be "restored" - i.e. just dmods suppressed w/o changing to
311                // actual base skin
312                //if (!v.getHullSpec().isDHull()) base = v.getHullSpec();
313                if (!v.getHullSpec().isDefaultDHull() && !v.getHullSpec().isRestoreToBase()) base = v.getHullSpec();
314                
315                if (base == null && v.getHullSpec().isRestoreToBase()) {
316                        base = v.getHullSpec().getBaseHull();
317                }
318                return base;
319        }
320        
321        public static void restoreToNonDHull(ShipVariantAPI v) {
322                ShipHullSpecAPI base = getBaseNonDHullFor(v);
323                
324                if (base != null) {
325                        //v.clearPermaMods();
326                        v.setHullSpecAPI(base);
327                }
328        }
